catalog.description: Look up member <member_number> and read their current savings balance. Returns: savings_balance (decimal). Possible business outcomes (legitimate answers, not errors): invalid_search_input, record_not_found. Side effects: none. Version 0.4.0.

catalog.name: open_holiday_share
catalog.description: Open a new Holiday Club sub-account for member <member_number> with an initial deposit of 25 dollars, and post it. Returns: new_share_suffix (string), confirmation_number (string).
